title: 第11章 灵器第12章 争夺
lines: 大殿中，有着不少身影，但与进入水府的总人数一比，却少了很多，少的那部分人，其中一小部分还未赶到，但更多的恐怕已经成为冰冷的尸体。
人群之中，萧滕等四大高手最特殊，四人站立之地，周围十米没人敢接近。
此时此刻，众人目光全都落在了大殿半空中的白色光罩上。
在那白色光罩之中，悬浮着七件兵器。
刀，剑，枪，盾，甲，锤，弓。
七件兵器，静静悬浮在半空之中，散发着令人心悸的波动。
“灵器！”
望着半空中的七件兵器，许辰瞳孔不由一缩。
这七件兵器，竟然都是灵器。
“此间主人，绝非真气境武者。”
许辰更加笃定了自己的猜测。
太商国，灵器的数量并不多，哪怕是下品灵器，也能令真气境武者为之争的头破血流。
而在这里竟然一次性出现了七件。
加上他前不久得到的灵器大鼎，这座水府之中，竟有八件灵器。
“接下来，势必迎来一场惨烈的厮杀！”
许辰目光一扫，发现在场所有人，脸上一副贪婪的盯着半空中的七件灵器。
“一将功成万骨枯。”
“进入水府的万人大军，最后能够活着走出的恐怕十不足一。”
“明知夺取灵器的希望不大，此刻也没人主动退出。”
许辰扪心自问，遇到这种天大的机缘，他也不会甘心退走，为了灵器，拼了命，也是值得。
他的目光在七件灵器上一一掠过，最后锁定在了灵剑之上。
剑，百兵之君！
剑气纵横三万里，一剑光寒十九洲！
他最爱的兵器便是剑。
他向往着仗剑走天涯的不羁生活！
除了自身本就喜爱长剑之外，他决心夺取灵剑的主要原因是，在他的感知之中，灵剑是这七件灵器中品质最好的。
许辰专注打量着灵剑之时，忽然感觉到数道不善的目光看向了他。
顺着充满敌意的目光看去，许辰看到了唐莫，杜重，还有流云宗的青衣青年。
唐莫在唐小天的耳边说了几句，下一刻，唐小天那如刀锋般锋利的目光便是射向许辰。
于此同时。
杜家的杜少秋，流云宗的赵毅，全部眼神不善的看向了许辰。
唐小天，杜少秋，赵毅，任意一人他都不是其对手，现在三人同时盯上了他。
许辰暗道不妙。
不动声色向后退去。
content_en:
There were many figures in the main hall, but compared with the total number of people who entered the water mansion, there were far fewer people. Of those less people, a small part of them had not arrived yet, but most of them were probably already cold corpses.
Among the crowd, Xiao Teng and the other four masters were the most special. Where the four of them stood, no one dared to approach within ten meters.
At this moment, everyone's eyes fell on the white light shield in the middle of the hall.
Within the white light shield, seven weapons were suspended.
Knife, sword, spear, shield, armor, hammer, bow.
The seven weapons were quietly suspended in mid-air, emitting heart-stopping fluctuations.
"Spiritual weapon!"
Looking at the seven weapons in mid-air, Xu Chen's pupils couldn't help but shrink.
These seven weapons are actually spiritual weapons.
"The master here is definitely not a true Qi realm warrior."
Xu Chen became more confident in his guess.
In the Taishang Kingdom, there are not many spiritual weapons. Even low-grade spiritual weapons can cause true energy realm warriors to fight over them with bloodshed.
And here, seven of them appeared at once.
In addition to the great spiritual weapon cauldron he obtained not long ago, there are actually eight spiritual weapons in this water mansion.
"Next, there will definitely be a brutal fight!"
Xu Chen glanced around and found that everyone present was staring greedily at the seven spiritual weapons in mid-air.
"One general's success will make a thousand bones wither."
"Of the tens of thousands of people who entered Shuifu, I'm afraid less than one out of ten will be able to walk out alive."
"Knowing that there is little hope of seizing the spiritual weapon, no one is voluntarily withdrawing at this moment."
Xu Chen asked himself, if he encountered such a great opportunity, he would not be willing to retreat. It was worth risking his life for the spiritual weapon.
His eyes passed over the seven spiritual weapons one by one, and finally locked on the spiritual sword.
Sword, the king of hundreds of weapons!
The sword energy spreads across thirty thousand miles, and the light of one sword chills nineteen continents!
His favorite weapon is the sword.
He yearns for the unruly life of traveling to the ends of the earth with a sword!
In addition to his own love for long swords, the main reason why he was determined to seize the spirit sword was that in his perception, the spirit sword was of the highest quality among the seven spiritual weapons.
While Xu Chen was looking at the spirit sword intently, he suddenly felt several unkind eyes looking at him.
Looking along the hostile gaze, Xu Chen saw Tang Mo, Du Zhong, and the young man in green from the Liuyun Sect.
Tang Mo said a few words in Tang Xiaotian's ear, and the next moment, Tang Xiaotian's sharp eyes as sharp as a blade were directed at Xu Chen.
At the same time.
Du Shaoqiu from the Du family and Zhao Yi from the Liuyun Sect all looked at Xu Chen with unkind eyes.
Tang Xiaotian, Du Shaoqiu, Zhao Yi, any one of them is no match for him, and now the three of them are eyeing him at the same time.
Xu Chen secretly thought something was wrong.
He backed away calmly.
